_description: Custom Reports KEPT-REPORT scenario (v3, checklist style) — builds a SESSIONS report over a CUSTOM date range, saves it, and INTENTIONALLY does NOT delete it. Column selection uses the CHECKLIST below: every key from choose-fields.catalog.json is listed with true/false — true puts the column in the report, false leaves it out. Keys are validated against the catalog at runtime (unknown/stale keys fail fast with suggestions). Set "selectAll": true at the top level to include EVERY field and skip the checklist.

_config._configNote: rangeMode=custom keeps the date inputs EDITABLE (preset modes disable them). Preview columns always render in PAGE order regardless of the checklist order.
_config._comment_subject: Allowed: "sessions" (one row per dialysis session) | "patients" (one row per patient) | "providers" (one row per provider, aggregated over the date ran).
_config._comment_rangeMode: Allowed: "daily" | "weekly" | "monthly" | "custom". The preset modes DISABLE the date inputs and derive the range themselves — only "custom" keeps dateFrom/dateTo editable.
_config._comment_dateFrom: Custom-range start. "YYYY-MM-DD" or templates "{{today_minus_N}}" / "{{today_plus_N}}" (N = days, always future-proof). Ignored unless rangeMode="custom".
_config._comment_dateTo: Custom-range end — same rules as dateFrom.
_config._comment_branchFilter: SELECT OPTION TEXT, exactly as in the dropdown: "All Branches" | "Main Branch" | "Jeddah" | "Branch 3" | "Branch 4" | "Branch 5" | "Branch 6" | "Branch 7". Empty "" = leave untouched (stays All Branches).
_config._comment_systemFilter: SELECT OPTION TEXT: "All Systems" | "In Center" | "Home Hemodialysis". Empty "" = leave untouched.
_config._comment_visitStatusFilter: SELECT OPTION TEXT: "All Statuses" | "In Active" | "In Progress" | "Start Procedure" | "End Procedure" | "Completed" | "Reopened" | "Co_sign" | "Canceled". Empty "" = leave untouched.
_config._comment_saveReport: "DYNAMIC" = unique name per run (recommended — re-runs never collide and old kept rows stay intact). Any other string = fixed display name.
_config._comment_frequency: Verified on staging: "one_time" (the only frequency radio the Save form currently renders).
_config._comment_visibility: Allowed: "private" (only you see it in My Reports) | "public" (visible to all users; row badge shows Public).
_config._comment_recipients: REQUIRED by the server form — leaving it empty makes the Save POST silently fail browser validation. Comma-separated emails, e.g. "a@x.com, b@x.com". Keep a .example domain in tests.
